data.gender_notes: Barina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Barina means 'bearer of good news'. This name is derived from the Greek word 'baros', meaning 'heavy, weighty'. In the context of the New Testament, 'baros' can also refer to the 'Word of God' which carries the weight of divine truth. The name Barina carries the meaning “Bearer of good news” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Barina usually hope their child will grow to embody bearer of good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name also reflects the role of Christians as bearers of this good news, and the responsibility and privilege that comes with sharing the message of faith with others.
